comparison.objective: Candidate installs a rack rail; record mounts the last section of a bicycle tire bead onto a rim.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate manipulates rigid linked rail parts and spring latches; record manages deformable bead slack bimanually through the drop center without a lever.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks rack-post retention and screws; record checks seated bead, required slack-generating arcs, and prohibited lever use or damage.
comparison.reason: Distinct rigid versus deformable mechanics and endpoint. Candidate lacks numeric force and damage thresholds, but there is no plausible duplicate.
